Hi James — thanks, and great to meet you over email. Quick note on logistics: I'm traveling early next week (onsite Monday-Wednesday) and will be partially unavailable for ad-hoc follow-ups. Given AcmeCloud's infra focus and the presence of an ML engineer on your side, I'd strongly recommend converting the planned 30–45 minute intro into a 90-minute hands-on sandbox session / POC scoping workshop so we can:

- validate network/KMS access patterns
- run a short inference job against a sample prompt set
- map token billing and latency expectations to your volume profile

I can run the workshop, but because of my travel I'll need to shift the slot to later in the week. Proposed alternatives (all PT):
- Thu, Feb 18 — 09:30–11:00 PT
- Fri, Feb 19 — 11:00–12:30 PT

If neither of those work, we can keep an intro this week and then schedule the sandbox for the following week; my preference is to do the sandbox first so your engineers get hands-on context.

I've attached a short draft agenda and prework checklist (POC-sandbox-agenda.pdf). Laura will own the prework doc and the Join link; Rishi will join for the cost/architecture portion. Could you confirm Sarah (infra) and your ML engineer's availability for one of the two slots?

If you prefer a different day/time, drop a few options and we'll try to accommodate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
